name: The Sistermon Sisters Training Gym
main_effect:
While you have a Digimon with [Huckmon] in its name the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with [Huckmon] or [Jesmon] in its name, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may play 1 card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
